app.status.summary: Show package version and verified administrator identity

paramsSchema.description: The entry page's DSM display-language hint

dsmLanguage.description: The caller's DSM display language as the entry page read it (cht, enu, …); empty when DSM follows the browser

ctl.connection.status.summary: Show connection states and failure codes; a pending sign-in returns its time-limited login link; connecting is not completed; pending sign-in links and codes are returned unchanged; finish browser authorization in the App

ctl.ports.list.summary: List configured local services and their current port detection state

ctl.ipv6.status.summary: Diagnose local IPv6 availability; local addresses do not prove Internet reachability

advisor.recommend.summary: Rank existing connection methods for a use without enabling any; each option lists its plain-language security and the first step, and steps needing consent or browser login say so in needs

tier.description: Order of the Cloudflare options, not a name: 1 Cloudflare temporary address, 2 Cloudflare own domain (web HTTPS)

scope.description: What one connection opens: one DSM web address, DSM and each app on its own address, chosen services one by one, a private network the devices join (the whole NAS on that network), or Synology's own services

https.description: Who provides HTTPS: Cloudflare's browser-trusted certificate (no DSM certificate or open port), a Tailscale ts.net certificate once HTTPS is on (else HTTP inside the tailnet), HTTP inside NetBird's WireGuard network, DSM's QuickConnect, or a certificate you set up in DSM for DDNS and IPv6

reasons.description: needs_tcp_services: the use runs over the method's TCP services (Tailscale carries Drive or SMB as a tailnet-only TCP mapping); no_protection: nothing stands between the internet and the service, so the option is never recommended

risk.description: Who reaches what: only your own devices, or a sign-in page anyone with the address sees

protection.description: What stands between the internet and the NAS: Cloudflare, a private network only your devices join, Synology's relay, or none (services face the internet directly, as with direct IPv6)

guide.description: The method's setup steps as message keys

gate.description: The sign-in in front of the NAS's own: Cloudflare Access email sign-in (own domain, optional), DSM sign-in before an app (Free link and own domain), signing in to the private network, or none

goal.description: apps: DSM and package web pages in a browser; services-web: a service such as Drive from its phone app or a browser (DSM HTTPS); services-desktop: a computer's TCP client such as Drive Client sync (TCP 6690); all: every service including SMB (445); omitted keeps catalog order

ctl.diagnose.summary: Explain each provider's state, connector, addresses and next step; a pending browser sign-in returns its time-limited login link for the calling administrator; query again after signing in

dsmExternal.description: DSM's External Access address against the stable address of a running own Cloudflare domain or token; a temporary trycloudflare address and private Tailscale or NetBird addresses are never suggested. next proposes external set; ask the user before running it

dsmSecurity.description: Whether DSM Auto Block and enforced 2-factor sign-in are on, read with the caller's own DSM session; unknown when DSM refuses the read (only administrators may read them). next holds a user step turn-on-auto-block or turn-on-dsm-2fa with DSM's official help url for each one that is off; Syno Connect Center never changes them

external.status.summary: Compare DSM's External Access address (Control Panel > External Access > Advanced) with the stable own-domain address Syno Connect Center runs; reads only

resultSchema.description: DSM's External Access address against the stable address of a running own Cloudflare domain or token; a temporary trycloudflare address and private Tailscale or NetBird addresses are never suggested. next proposes external set; ask the user before running it

external.set.summary: Set DSM's advertised External Access host name and ports with the administrator's own DSM session; DSM's listening ports do not change; the same values again change nothing

resultSchema.description: changed is false when DSM already had every value; previous is the value before, for restoring

advice.description: DSM's External Access address against the stable address of a running own Cloudflare domain or token; a temporary trycloudflare address and private Tailscale or NetBird addresses are never suggested. next proposes external set; ask the user before running it

paramsSchema.description: Only the given fields change; use diagnose's dsmExternal.suggested and ask the user first

hostname.description: Host name or IP address DSM advertises for external links; empty clears it

httpPort.description: Advertised external HTTP port; must differ from httpsPort

ctl.connection.disconnect.summary: Request disconnection without forgetting saved settings; read connection status to confirm stopped

paramsSchema.description: Stop one provider or all providers; does not remove saved configuration

provider.description: Provider to stop; omitted or all stops every provider

ctl.connection.connect.summary: Configure or reconnect a provider; returns acceptance, not completion; query diagnose for the login link; binary_required returns state connector-required with the next commands; pending sign-in links and codes are returned unchanged; finish browser authorization in the App

mode.description: Cloudflare temporary address or own-domain setup/reconnect

subdomain.description: Optional Cloudflare domain label; fill locally

token.description: Optional Tailscale auth key or NetBird setup key; JSON file/stdin only

confirmExposure.description: Explicit administrator consent to expose the configured services; --yes does not replace it

replace.description: Accept that the running connection drops for about a minute while a change it cannot keep is applied

loginServer.description: Optional HTTPS Headscale login server origin

loginOrigin.description: Optional trusted HTTPS Headscale browser login origin

loginOrigins.description: Explicitly trusted HTTPS NetBird login origins

confirmManagementPolicy.description: Consent to self-hosted NetBird management policy when using a setup key

serviceIds.description: IPv6 service IDs from ports list; omit to use enabled services

connection.check.summary: Start or read the existing bounded background connection probe; checking is pending and externalVerified=false is not outside reachability

ctl.connection.forget.summary: Forget a disconnected provider's saved service bindings; disconnect first; does not delete cloud resources

ctl.ports.followset.summary: Follow installed TCP service declarations on Tailscale private networks only; enabling requires consent

ctl.cloudflare.access.status.summary: Read email restriction counts and sync status without private addresses

ctl.cloudflare.access.set.summary: Replace the shared email list; native clients cannot pass Access and active public streams close

emails.description: Complete replacement list; use a local JSON input file, never command-line email values

confirm.description: Confirm native Photos, DS file and Drive clients cannot use this address; browser login does not authorize them

ctl.cloudflare.access.sync.summary: Check and repair owned Access apps without changing foreign settings

ctl.ports.upsert.summary: Add or edit a custom local service; enabling requires explicit exposure consent

id.description: Custom service ID from ports list; omit when adding a service

name.description: Service display name; keep private text in a local JSON input file

enabled.description: Whether providers may expose this service

confirmExposure.description: Explicit exposure consent for enabled service

ctl.ports.delete.summary: Delete one custom service mapping; built-in DSM services cannot be deleted

id.description: Custom service ID from ports list; omit when adding a service

ctl.ports.dsmset.summary: Enable or disable a detected DSM service mapping; does not change DSM settings

enabled.description: Whether providers may expose the detected DSM service
